attributes.name: Mace of Smiting
attributes.powers: For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d8+3; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d4. If the check is against a bane that has the Construct or Outsider trait, add another 2d8. If a monster has an effect that increases the difficulty of that check, ignore that effect.

corrections.corrected_text: On the weapon Mace of Smiting, replace "If a monster has an effect that increases the difficulty of a combat check, ignore that effect" with "If a monster has an effect that increases the difficulty of that check, ignore that effect".
corrections.issue: Mace of Smiting says I can ignore a monster's effects that increase the difficulty of a combat check. Does that include, for example, the difficulty increase from a monster with the Veteran trait, even though that power doesn't specifically say it affects combat checks?
